title: Oppression of Eglon King of Moab (18 years)
summary: Eglon of Moab, with Ammon and Amalek, takes the city of palm trees; Israel serves him eighteen years (Judg 3:12–14).
description: Judges-period record added from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display) with Ussher, Jones and, where available, CFAH-1 Table 1 dates for sorting. Jordan treats the judgeships as partly overlapping regional sequences (North / Centre / South) fitted to the 480 years of 1 Kgs 6:1 and the 300 years of Judg 11:26.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1378 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

chronologies.date: "1378 BC / 2626 AM": 18 years of Eglon of Moab, 1378–1360 BC
chronologies.citation: Jones, Chart No. 4 "Judges to the First 3 Kings" (© 1993 Floyd Jones; chart text revised "As of 2007"), timeline band
Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §345 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 51
chronologies.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry.

chronologies.date: "2642 - Death of Othniel, beginning of Eglon's 18-year oppression (Jud. 3:11-12)"
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
chronologies.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory). BC 5:2: "A year before the sabbath of 2643, Eglon of Moab conquered Israel and oppressed her for 18 years (in 2642)."
